review_candidates.description: Company Description Mona Trading LLC, founded in 1973, has grown from a small regional company into a reputable large enterprise serving manufacturing, industrial, oil & gas, and construction sectors across a wide region. The company is recognized for introducing new and innovative technologies, delivering optimal quality, and providing comprehensive services to its clients. Mona Trading emphasizes strong ethical principles and mutual trust in its long-standing relationships with customers and suppliers. The organization offers a stable, growth-oriented environment where team members contribute to impactful projects in critical industries. Role Description The Human Resources Analytics Specialist is a full-time hybrid role based in Cairo, Egypt, with the flexibility to perform some tasks from home. In this role, the specialist will collect, analyze, and interpret HR and workforce data to support evidence-based decision-making across the organization. Daily responsibilities include preparing dashboards and reports, conducting people analytics studies, identifying trends in recruitment, retention, performance, and engagement, and recommending data-driven improvements to HR policies and programs. The specialist will collaborate with HR and business leaders to define key metrics, ensure data accuracy, and translate complex insights into clear, actionable recommendations. Additional tasks may involve supporting HR system enhancements, maintaining data governance standards, and contributing to strategic workforce planning initiatives. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in People Analytics and HR Analytics to design, execute, and interpret workforce-related analyses. Candidates should possess solid Human Resources (HR) knowledge to understand HR processes, policies, and organizational dynamics. Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills and Data Analytics capabilities to manage data sets, build dashboards, and generate actionable insights. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field; a relevant master’s degree or professional certification in HR or analytics is an advantage. Experience with HRIS systems, data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and advanced Excel; familiarity with statistical or scripting tools (e.g., SQL, R, Python) is beneficial. Strong communication skills, with the ability to present complex data findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Proven ability to work in a hybrid environment, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
